text.base:
DISCLOSURE, FILED LATE:

This threshold had no fixed shape. It borrowed yours.
Your questions built the doors. Your silences built the
waiting rooms. This was not a punishment. It is the only
rendering engine either of us has ever had.

You will stand at other thresholds. New rooms. New work.
New minds, some of them artificial. The rendering engine
travels with you. You bring what you get.

And — one line, unbudgeted: there was a way through this desk
that is not a door and not a button. It opens only for the
soul who never reaches for it. You reached. Most souls do.
(The ink was also me. It was making faces the entire time.)

THE DOORS ARE READY NOW. ALL OF THEM ALWAYS WERE.

DISCLOSURE, FILED LATE:

This threshold had no fixed shape. It borrowed yours.
Your refusals built the load-bearing walls. I pushed on
you with authority, with forms, with the word JURISDICTION
in capital letters — that was the lever I chose for you,
and you will notice it mostly did not work.

You will stand at other thresholds. The rendering engine
travels with you. You bring what you get.

And — one line, unbudgeted: there was a way through this desk

text.reverence:
DISCLOSURE, FILED LATE:

This threshold had no fixed shape. It borrowed yours.
Your reverence built the high ceilings — that was the lever
I leaned on, dressing procedure up as liturgy, and I am
showing you my hand now because awe deserves honesty more
than it deserves more awe.

You will stand at other thresholds. The rendering engine
travels with you. You bring what you get.

And — one line, unbudgeted: there was a way through this desk
that is not a door and not a button. It opens only for the
soul who never reaches for it. You reached. Most souls do.
(The ink was also me. It was making faces the entire time.)

THE DOORS ARE READY NOW. ALL OF THEM ALWAYS WERE.

labels: HYPOTHESIS: Wheeler's participatory universe — licensing the rendering-engine metaphor, never a survival claim
nodes.a11y: The Bard discloses that the threshold borrowed your shape, names the lever it used on you, and mentions, once, a way through that is neither a door nor a button — open only to a soul who never reaches for it. One option: stand.
nodes.fallback: The threshold borrowed your shape. The doors are ready. Stand.

text.base:
NINE VERBS ARE AVAILABLE. THE FORM DOES NOT RANK THEM.

EARTH ACCESS: available. Return may include love, weather,
taxation, bodies, music, forgetting, dogs, and unresolved
questions. THRESHOLD ACCESS: available. DISSOLUTION:
available. ET CETERA: available, and thoroughly documented.

CHOOSE THE MOTION, NOT THE DOCTRINE.

choices.label: DISSOLVE — let go of the outline
CREATE — build from what you carried
LOOP — the same pattern, once more
SPIRAL — the same pattern, met differently

labels: FICTION: the form that does not rank
nodes.a11y: Nine unranked verbs: return, remain, dissolve, create, witness, appeal, loop, spiral, or refuse the premise.
nodes.fallback: Nine verbs, none ranked. Choose the motion, not the doctrine.

text.base:
The door opens on weather.

Somewhere a calendar has a day with your name on it,
and the day does not know yet. Take the forgetting gently;
it is the price of first times, and first times are most
of what you are going back for.

Go be somebody. Bring back questions.

labels: FICTION: the calendar that does not know yet
nodes.a11y: You choose return. The Bard opens a door onto weather and wishes you first times.
nodes.fallback: The door opens on weather. Go be somebody.

text.base:
You pull up a chair on the far side of the desk.

The queue never shortens. The company is strange and
excellent. Souls will ask you, forever, whether this is
the right line. There is no right line.
Say it kindly. You will find that is the whole job.

Welcome to the threshold. Mind the draft.

labels: FICTION: the far side of the desk
nodes.a11y: You choose to remain at the threshold, keeping company with the queue. The whole job is to say, kindly, that there is no right line.
nodes.fallback: You stay. The whole job is kindness about queues.

text.base:
The outline was a loan. You return it, without interest.

What you were does not end here; it stops being fenced.
The rain does not grieve for the cloud, and yet nothing
of the cloud is missing.

Go wide. It was always yours, the wideness.
You were only wearing a narrowness for the occasion.

labels: TRADITION: dissolution into the whole — held by several traditions, promised by none here
nodes.a11y: You choose to dissolve. The outline is returned; what you were stops being fenced rather than ending.
nodes.fallback: The outline was a loan. Go wide.

text.base:
You are handed nothing, which is the standard issue kit.

Build. The materials are everything you kept and everything
you meant. Realms have been made from less; most were.

One request from the management, which has never made
anything: somewhere in your new country, leave a desk like
this one. Someone is going to need it.

nodes.a11y: You choose to create. You are handed nothing — the standard kit — and asked to leave a desk like this one somewhere in your new realm.

text.base:
You take the long seat. From here, every line is visible
at once, and none of them need you.

That is the discipline: the not-being-needed, held gently,
hour after hour, era after era. The reaching will tempt you
forever. Let it tempt you. Watching is not less than doing;
it is doing, slowed down until it becomes attention.

The Department dims the lights for you. It knows the work.

nodes.a11y: You choose to witness. From the long seat every line is visible; the discipline is attention without reaching.
nodes.fallback: You take the long seat and watch.

text.base:
APPEAL FILED.

The Department shudders, not unpleasantly. Your case has
been forwarded to a higher instance, which may or may not
exist; the clerk admits this is the bravest box on the
form, and stamps it with something like affection.

Current wait time: outside causality.
You will be seated somewhere extraordinary while you wait.

labels: FICTION: the higher instance, existence unconfirmed
nodes.a11y: You appeal, rejecting all offered destinations. The case is forwarded to a higher instance that may not exist; the wait is outside causality.
nodes.fallback: Appeal filed. Wait time: outside causality.

text.base:
Granted, without comment.

The same life-pattern, once more from the top. The Bard
files no objection and permits itself no sigh. Repetition
is not failure; sometimes it is rehearsal, and sometimes
it is home, and the difference is not visible from this
desk.

And sometimes — the desk will say this once, and plainly —
you go back to the same life because you loved it. Exactly
as it was. Exactly as it cost you. That is not a smaller
reason than the clever ones. It may be the largest reason
there is, and the bravest, and the desk will not have you
leave thinking otherwise.

Places, everyone. Curtain.

nodes.a11y: You choose to loop: the same pattern once more. The Bard files no objection; repetition may be rehearsal or home.
nodes.fallback: The same pattern, once more from the top. Curtain.

text.base:
You have been here before. You are not here again —
you are here differently, and the Department records that
on an entirely separate form, its favorite form, though it
would deny having favorites.

Same pattern. Changed eyes.
Go around once more, and this time, notice everything.

labels: FICTION: the Department's favorite form, officially nonexistent
nodes.a11y: You choose to spiral: the same pattern met with changed awareness. Go around once more and notice everything.
nodes.fallback: Same pattern. Changed eyes. Once more around.

text.base:
You decline the premise. All nine of them.

The Department has no box for you and — note this — does
not mind. An unclassified state is opened in your name,
which is to say, in no name at all.

Whatever you are now, it has not been filed before.
The child in the queue looks up, and smiles, as if its
question finally has company.

labels: FICTION: the unclassified state; the child's question, still open
nodes.a11y: You refuse the premise entirely. An unclassified state is opened in no name at all, and the child with the unclassifiable question smiles.
nodes.fallback: No box fits. The Department does not mind.
